brand.school_name: Applied Technology School for Nuclear Energy in El-Dabaa

hero_items.title: Welcome to the Applied Technology School for Nuclear Energy in El-Dabaa (ATSNEE)
hero_items.description: The First and Only School of Its Kind in Africa and the Arab World!

hero_items.title: The next generation of leaders in Electronics, Electricity, Mechanics, and Nuclear Engineering.
A highly selective admissions process
hero_items.description: we accept only 60 students each year, creating a group of outstanding and driven individuals

industry_collaboration.title: Strong Industry Collaboration
industry_collaboration.subtitle: Collaborations
industry_collaboration.description: The school's collaboration with the Egyptian Nuclear Power Plants Authority provides students many powerful internships and direct access to work opportunities in their field, either immediately after graduation or while they continue their engineering degrees.

expert_faculty.title: Expert Faculty
expert_faculty.subtitle: Education
expert_faculty.description: A teaching staff composed of expert professors and selective teachers with backgrounds in nuclear engineering, physics, and other specialized fields. The faculty includes leaders from Egypt’s top research institutions, ensuring students receive world-class education.

innovation.title: Focus on Innovation and Community Impact
innovation.subtitle: Innovation
innovation.description: The school aims to create a better community through education, research, and innovation. Students are encouraged to not only excel academically but also contribute to advancements in nuclear technology and engineering, making a positive societal impact.

rigorous_curriculum.title: Rigorous and Comprehensive Curriculum
rigorous_curriculum.subtitle: Academics
rigorous_curriculum.description: With a curriculum that blends theoretical knowledge and hands-on training in electricity, electronics, mechanics, and nuclear physics, students graduate with highly competitive skills that set them apart in both higher education and the job market. The inclusion of graduation projects and practical labs further enhances their learning experience.
